notes.title: The Botanist - Patch 2.5v
notes.notes:
Dear Botanist Fans,

We’d like to thank all of you for the heartwarming words of support, constructive feedback, and patience as we improve the game and address the issues some of you have encountered.

Our team has been working very hard and we are extremely excited to deliver patch 2.5v for The Botanist, full of new features, improvements and fixes to all of you!

Patch Release Notes:

 Mushroom chest. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36834036/a311ed0467270c6ddaf4fed11d146be986f4c5d3.png

 New map decoration. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36834036/030bf24447e16ea1cfafd96218e0db01e8ac03c1.png

 New player dialogs. 
 Colliding improvement.


Expect more updates soon.
Enjoy the game!

With respect,
Ghost Team

notes.title: The Botanist - Patch 2.3v
notes.notes:
Dear Botanist Fans,

We’d like to thank all of you for the heartwarming words of support, constructive feedback, and patience as we improve the game and address the issues some of you have encountered.

Our team has been working very hard and we are extremely excited to deliver patch 2.3v for The Botanist, full of new features, improvements and fixes to all of you!

Patch Release Notes:
Graphical Improvement

New lightning system.
Graphical colors are now more smooth and colorful, with sharper shadows and warmer light.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36834036/329ea497d39f650474049f8c0d45710ca2d174a2.png
New particle system.
We added more particles and animations making the map more realistic.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36834036/bdfd0b6bab3b86db610a2fbb60629214bd63f7d5.png
New Skies.
Old day and night skies have been replaced with new and fresh looking dawn, day, night and twilight skies.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36834036/bd15ef68258acdb6ff427be2e412557b76567bdf.png
New Platforms and plants.
We expanded the playground, making the game even more interesting for our players.

Sound Improvement

Rain sound system.
The sound of the rain is now smoother.
Background sound system.
Background music will always play if the slider is higher than zero.

Game optimization

Player animations.
When you fall down with the box, you will see new falling animation. Also, there's no more delay between animation transitions. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36834036/84fcc40136db915ae8ef5f31730c12c29f91e786.png
Camera fading system.
You can fade now all types of platforms, traps, houses, plants...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36834036/ff0927df8155be45b155d199cc6042523e0540cc.png
Save game logic.
Now your game progress will be saved if you take checkpoint and if you put the box on one of the box placements.
Box logic.
Problems with the box has been fixed.


Expect more updates soon.
Enjoy the game!

With respect,
Ghost Team
